title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #18

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why does no other person have the same fingerprints as you? (1 mark)
   A. Every person is unique
   B. Fingerprints are drawn at birth
   C. Only twins have fingerprints
   D. Fingerprints change every day

2. What is a consequence? (1 mark)
   A. A result of what we choose
   B. A school subject
   C. A type of song
   D. A holiday

3. What is a choice? (1 mark)
   A. A decision to do one thing instead of another
   B. A kind of food
   C. A school rule
   D. A gift from a friend

4. Which question helps you to choose rightly? (1 mark)
   A. What is the cheapest?
   B. Who will laugh at me?
   C. Will I get away with it?
   D. Does this agree with what God teaches?

5. Which of these is an attribute of God taught in this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Unknown
   B. Forgetful
   C. Weak
   D. Sole Creator

6. Which of these is a sign of real repentance? (1 mark)
   A. Only saying sorry with words
   B. Repeating the wrong
   C. Making things right with those we wronged
   D. Hiding the wrong

7. Which word best describes a person who is honest even when nobody sees? (1 mark)
   A. Integrity
   B. Pride
   C. Greed
   D. Jealousy

8. How much would Zacchaeus pay back to anyone he had cheated? (1 mark)
   A. Four times the amount
   B. Twice
   C. Ten times
   D. Half

9. Which lesson do we learn from Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. Curse enemies
   B. Ignore God
   C. Obey God and speak only what He says
   D. Follow money

10. What animal attacked Samson near Timnah? (1 mark)
   A. A snake
   B. A wolf
   C. A young lion
   D. A bear

11. What did Samson find later in the body of the lion? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Gold
   C. Bees and honey
   D. A snake

12. What is a judge in the book of Judges? (1 mark)
   A. A court officer today
   B. A priest
   C. A king
   D. A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel

13. Why is Joseph a good example of leadership? (1 mark)
   A. He was rude
   B. He was lazy
   C. He was honest, wise and hardworking
   D. He was selfish

14. Whom did Joseph credit for the interpretation? (1 mark)
   A. The magicians
   B. God
   C. The cupbearer
   D. Himself

15. What lesson can we learn from Joseph's plan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the future
   B. Take all the food
   C. Spend everything
   D. Plan and save for hard times

16. How old was Abram when God changed his name? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 99
   C. 75
   D. 120

17. Which verse says that nothing is impossible with God? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Luke 7:14

18. What did Bartimaeus do when Jesus called him? (1 mark)
   A. Stayed sitting
   B. Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   C. Hid
   D. Ran away

19. What happened after Jesus spoke? (1 mark)
   A. He ran away
   B. Nothing
   C. The dead man sat up and began to talk
   D. The crowd left

20. Which statement about forgiveness is true? (1 mark)
   A. Forgiving is a sign of weakness
   B. Forgiving takes courage
   C. Forgiving means the wrong was fine
   D. Forgiving means telling lies

21. Which of these is an emotional need? (1 mark)
   A. A pencil
   B. A meal
   C. Someone to listen
   D. A new pair of shoes

22. What does a person do when they repent, causing joy in heaven? (1 mark)
   A. They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   B. To blame others
   C. To ignore sin
   D. To hide sin

23. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson
   B. A prayer
   C. A song
   D. A kind of coin

24. How many people were baptised on the day of Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. About three
   B. About three hundred
   C. About three thousand
   D. About thirty

25. Which verse tells us to speak truthfully to our neighbour? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Ephesians 4:25
   D. John 3:16

26. What is one result of lying? (1 mark)
   A. Peace of mind
   B. Better marks
   C. Loss of trust
   D. More friends

27. Which verse tells children to obey parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Genesis 12:1
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. Ephesians 6:1

28. Why should we obey teachers? (1 mark)
   A. For fun
   B. They guide us and help us learn
   C. They are our enemies
   D. To be punished

29. Which is a personal item? (1 mark)
   A. The school gate
   B. A classroom desk
   C. A library book
   D. A school uniform

30. What does Luke 16:10 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Be greedy
   B. Money is evil
   C. Do not work
   D. Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much

31. Which is a sin? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing
   B. Praying
   C. Helping
   D. Sharing

32. Which of these is harmful to the body? (1 mark)
   A. Sleep
   B. Alcohol and drugs
   C. Vegetables
   D. Water

33. Which of these is a result of sin? (1 mark)
   A. It separates us from God
   B. It brings peace
   C. It brings health
   D. It brings praise

34. Why did Jesus drive out the buyers and sellers? (1 mark)
   A. They were misusing God's house
   B. They were children
   C. They were poor
   D. They were noisy

35. How many disciples did Jesus choose? (1 mark)
   A. Twelve
   B. Twenty
   C. Seven
   D. Ten

36. What came upon the disciples at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. An army
   B. A king
   C. A storm only
   D. The Holy Spirit

37. What does joy mean for a Christian? (1 mark)
   A. Having no problems
   B. Being rich
   C. Deep gladness from knowing God
   D. Only laughing

38. Who helps believers to show the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. The market
   B. The Holy Spirit
   C. The king
   D. The neighbour

39. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Watching a lesson
   B. Sharing kind words
   C. Praying online
   D. Sending hurtful messages to others

40. Which of these is a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. A mobile phone
   B. A chair
   C. A pencil
   D. A stone

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. State two things the angel Gabriel said about the child that Mary would bear. (2 marks)

42. Describe how Jesus responded when Bartimaeus called for mercy. (3 marks)

43. Give three ways in which children can care for animals. (3 marks)

44. Name two ways of showing compassion to a grieving neighbour. (2 marks)

45. State three qualities of good giving. (3 marks)

46. Explain the lessons that we learn from Matthew 21:12-14. (5 marks)

47. Name the three places in the journey of Abram, in order. (2 marks)

48. Describe four ways of growing the fruit of the Spirit. (4 marks)

49. State three things that show that Nicodemus changed. (3 marks)

50. Give three ways of turning away from sin and living righteously. (3 marks)

51. Explain how Luke 16:10 and Genesis 2:15 teach responsibility, and give examples from school and home. (5 marks)

52. Name two needs that people may have. (2 marks)

53. Describe four ways in which a child can trust God in life's challenges. (4 marks)

54. Give three ways of obeying God in daily life. (3 marks)

55. Explain why Joseph said, "I cannot do it, but God will give Pharaoh the answer". (3 marks)

56. Explain what it means to be assertive and give an example. (4 marks)

57. Give two examples of personal information that you should not share online. (2 marks)

58. State three ways of thanking God every day. (3 marks)

59. Name two people you can trust at home or school. (2 marks)

60. Who were the parents of John the Baptist? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Every person is unique
   Fingerprints show that each person is one of a kind.

2. A — A result of what we choose
   A consequence is the result of a choice.

3. A — A decision to do one thing instead of another
   A choice means deciding between different actions.

4. D — Does this agree with what God teaches?
   We measure choices by God's word.

5. D — Sole Creator
   God is the sole Creator, loving Father and holy.

6. C — Making things right with those we wronged
   Zacchaeus showed repentance by paying back.

7. A — Integrity
   Integrity means doing right when nobody is watching.

8. A — Four times the amount
   He promised to pay back four times.

9. C — Obey God and speak only what He says
   Balaam had to speak only God's words.

10. C — A young lion
   Judges 14:5 says a young lion came roaring towards him.

11. C — Bees and honey
   Judges 14:8 says a swarm of bees and honey were there.

12. D — A leader raised up by God to rescue Israel
   Judges were leaders who rescued Israel.

13. C — He was honest, wise and hardworking
   These qualities helped him to lead Egypt well.

14. B — God
   Joseph said, "God will give Pharaoh the answer."

15. D — Plan and save for hard times
   Joseph advised saving in good years.

16. B — 99
   Genesis 17:1 says he was ninety-nine.

17. C — Luke 1:37
   Luke 1:37 is the memory verse of this topic.

18. B — Threw his cloak aside and jumped up
   He threw off his cloak and came to Jesus.

19. C — The dead man sat up and began to talk
   Luke 7:15 says he sat up and began to talk.

20. B — Forgiving takes courage
   Forgiveness is strong, not weak.

21. C — Someone to listen
   Emotional needs include comfort and friendship.

22. A — They are sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repenting means turning back to God.

23. A — A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson
   Jesus used parables to teach.

24. C — About three thousand
   Acts 2:41 says about three thousand.

25. C — Ephesians 4:25
   Ephesians 4:25 says to put off falsehood.

26. C — Loss of trust
   People stop trusting a liar.

27. D — Ephesians 6:1
   Ephesians 6:1 says this.

28. B — They guide us and help us learn
   Teachers care for our progress and safety.

29. D — A school uniform
   Personal items belong to you.

30. D — Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much
   Faithfulness in small things matters.

31. A — Stealing
   Stealing is taking what is not yours.

32. B — Alcohol and drugs
   Drugs and alcohol harm the body.

33. A — It separates us from God
   Sin harms us and others.

34. A — They were misusing God's house
   The temple was for prayer, not trading.

35. A — Twelve
   Matthew 10:1 speaks of twelve.

36. D — The Holy Spirit
   Acts 2 tells of the Holy Spirit.

37. C — Deep gladness from knowing God
   Joy comes from God.

38. B — The Holy Spirit
   The Spirit grows the fruit.

39. D — Sending hurtful messages to others
   Bullying can happen online.

40. A — A mobile phone
   A phone is an electronic device.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: He will be great, He will be called Son of the Most High, He will have the throne of David, His kingdom will never end. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid statement.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." He asked what he wanted, then healed him and told him that his faith had healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stopping, 1 for asking, 1 for healing.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give them food and water; protect them from harm; do not beat them; do not overload them; give them shelter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Visit, comfort, share food, pray with them. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cheerful, quiet, respectful, useful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: The house of God is holy; it is for prayer; we must not misuse it or cheat others; Jesus cares about what happens there; it is a place of healing and help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson up to 5.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ur, Haran, Canaan.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct places and 1 mark for the correct order.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, practise one fruit at a time, ask for encouragement, say sorry and try again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: He defended Jesus fairly; he brought spices for Jesus' burial; he showed courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid sign.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say sorry to God; be honest; be kind; obey parents; pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

51. (5 marks)
   Answer: Luke 16:10 says being faithful in small things leads to bigger tasks. Genesis 2:15 says God gave people work to do and things to care for. At school a child covers books and cleans the class. At home a child washes plates and looks after younger siblings.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse meaning, 1 for a school example, 1 for a home example, 1 for a clear link.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing, shelter, medicine, school items, friendship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid need.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray; read the Bible; ask trusted adults; do their best; thank God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Obey parents and teachers, read and follow the Bible, tell the truth, pray, be kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Joseph knew that wisdom comes from God. He was humble and did not boast. He gave God the honour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wisdom from God, 1 for humility, 1 for honouring God.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being assertive means standing for what is right calmly and firmly. Example: refusing to copy in a test and politely saying, "No, that is cheating."
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 for calm and firm, 1 for example, 1 for clear explanation.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Home address, school, phone number, passwords, family photos.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing songs of praise, worship at church, use His gifts well, write a thank-you note.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parent, guardian, teacher, counsellor, grandparent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Zechariah and Elizabeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.
